description: Get the full record for an Open Library work — the book as a whole, across all its editions: description, subjects, authors, first publication date, cover and external links. Takes the `open_library_work_key` returned by `search_books`, `get_book_by_title` or `get_book_by_id`. Use `get_work_editions` to list the work's editions.

work_key.description: The Open Library work key, e.g. OL45804W. The /works/OL45804W form returned by search_books, get_book_by_title and get_book_by_id is also accepted.

name: get_work
title: Get work details
